text:
anna_sales: Quick heads-up — prospect SilkRoute is evaluating a drop-in replacement for their current LLM vendor. They want a short POC (2 weeks), answers to security Qs, and a pricing delta estimate. Can we sync ownership + high-level checklist?

devon_se: I can own the POC tech lead. Need to know which endpoints/features they depend on (streaming, function-calling, embeddings, reranking). Any sample traffic patterns?

anna_sales: They use streaming chat heavily + custom tool calls. Rough numbers: 200k chat tokens/day (peak 40k/hr), 50k embedding units/week. Also rely on prefix caching for session continuity.

maria_ml: Important callout — SilkRoute uses a slightly different tokenization for prompt length accounting; we'll want to run a token-delta test. Also their prompts rely on the vendor's response truncation behavior.

ryan_solutions: For the POC we should provide a compatibility shim example. Minimal mapping: endpoint names, streaming chunk framing, and tool-calling webhook format. Example shim snippet:```python
# pseudo-adapter
resp = redwood.generate(stream=True, model="rwd-chat-1", prompt=payload['prompt'])
for chunk in resp: client.write(chunk['delta'])
```

devon_se: Good. Also flag rate-limit header differences — SilkRoute expects `X-Rate-Limit-Remaining` style headers; our hosted API exposes `x-rw-rl-*`. We'll document a small header-mapping table.

sean_security: I'll pick up the security questionnaire. Need to know: SOC 2 status, data-at-rest encryption details, support for customer-managed KMS, VPC/private deployment options, retention controls, and whether we allow raw request logging for PII review. Any existing answers we can reuse?

anna_sales: Use the standard Redwood security pack but note this is an enterprise prospect so include options for Private (VPC) and on-prem. Also confirm we can toggle request retention for POC.

maria_ml: For quality parity tests we should provide (1) token-delta report, (2) prompt-template equivalence check, (3) 50 prompt evals comparing top-k/top-p sampling settings. I can run eval harness if we get sample prompts.

ryan_solutions: Action items: Devon -> adapter shim PR + README; Maria -> eval harness + token-delta; Sean -> security QA + ATO notes; Anna -> pricing delta and POC SOW. ETA: 3 business days for initial drafts.

devon_se: Quick note on function-calling: SilkRoute's tool-calling PUTs back JSON with snake_case keys. Our function-caller uses camelCase by default. Will push an option: `function_key_transform='snake'`.

sean_security: Also confirm our default encryption for Dedicated vs Private. For Private we should document support for customer KMS and HSM. I'll attach the snippets to the questionnaire.

anna_sales: Pricing ask from prospect: can we provide a limited-time discounted rate for first 2 months + dev credits for the POC? I can negotiate but need a ballpark delta per 1M tokens and per 10k embeddings to present.

ryan_solutions: For POC we can offer 50% off hosted per-token and 10k free embedding units. If they go Dedicated we will provide reserved pricing guidance. I'll put numbers in the SOW draft.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "SilkRoute POC kickoff" on 2026-03-25 10:00 — guests: anna_sales, devon_se, maria_ml, ryan_solutions, sean_security

anna_sales: Thanks — I'll confirm the sample prompts from SilkRoute and share the security questionnaire link. If anyone uncovers blocker (e.g., mandatory vendor-specific header we can't emulate), flag here immediately. :thumbsup:

maria_ml: I'll queue the eval jobs once prompts arrive. Planning to output a short report: token mapping, sample responses, and failure cases.

devon_se: Starting adapter PR today. Will include streaming example, header mapping, and a small Docker demo that runs locally against SilkRoute-compatible endpoints.

ryan_solutions: I'll draft the SOW/pricing and share by EOD tomorrow.

sean_security: Putting the security questionnaire in the shared folder and filling known answers. Will ping for anything I can't answer.

anna_sales: Great, locking owners. We'll reconvene after PR + draft SOW are ready.
